links.comparator_used: Female vs male infectious disease specialist persona in the prompt (no persona-free arm)
links.outcome: Top-five diagnostic accuracy for visceral leishmaniasis and Chagas disease across four LLMs
links.effect: VL: female prompt numerically higher in all four models (gains of 8.3–16.7 percentage points), ChatGPT-4o reaching 91.7%. CD: ChatGPT-4o 100% under both conditions; LLaMA 3 70B and Mixtral 8x7B improved by 16.7 percentage points with the female prompt; Meditron-70B stayed at 16.7%. No between-prompt differences were statistically significant (all p>0.05).
links.quote: The gender assigned to the physician persona produced subtle, nonsignificant variations in LLM diagnostic accuracy, with a consistent numerical trend favoring the female prompt in open-weight models.
